info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Banking Operational Services Delinquent Account Handling By Delinquent Account Handling Id-v5-spec
info.description: The Delinquent Account Management API facilitates the update of operational handling strategies for delinquent accounts within the banking system. By targeting specific delinquent account handling IDs, this API allows financial institutions to modify status, repayment plans, or account management approaches effectively. Typical consumers include banking operations teams and financial analysts working to improve delinquency rates and streamline collections processes. This ensures that each account is managed according to the latest operational guidelines and compliance requirements.

patch.description: Perform a partial update on the delinquent account handling for the specified account. This operation allows you to modify specific fields related to the account's delinquency status and management actions.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the delinquent account handling for the specified operation. It should contain the necessary fields to modify the account status or related information as per the operational requirements.
